content: Bab-Jesús-igargi-arbaega Bernabé, Sauloʼbo barmilesad
Antioquía-neggweburgine Jesúsʼba-nanaimalad-danar-ambikunonidamalad-abargi, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogmalad, dulemar-odurdakmalad, gudigusmalad. Amardi, wemalad:
Wemar, ibagwengi mas-gunsuli Bab-Dummadse-gorbukmargu, Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaled ega sognonikid: “Bernabé, Saulo-ebo anga nugsamalo, adi, an oarbabi-gunaidse barmidegar.”
Mas-gunsuli-Babse-gochamalad-sorba, Bernabé-nonogi, degi, Saulo-nonogi argan mesismalad, adi, oyogegar, Bab-Dummad wemar-susye. A-sorba, Bernabé, Saulo-ebo barmismarsunnad.
Bernabé, Saulo-ebo Chipre-dupse nadegusad
Bernabé, Saulo-ebo Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaled-sogedba barmilesmargu, Seleucia-neggweburse nadmalad. Agi mai, urgi Chipre-dupse obakde gusmalad.
Ar Bernabé, Saulo-ebo Salamina-neggweburse-mosmargu, Judíoʼmar-onmakednegmargi Bab-Dummad-gayaburbagi sunmakdemalad. Juan-Marcos, emar-bendakegala, eba nadapgusmogad.

Bela Chipre-dupugi neggwebur-bukmaladse ataksamargu, Pafos-neggweburse modapmalad. Agi Judío-wargwen, Barjesúsʼye-nugad abinguarmalad. We-dulede, ibmar-burba-wisidid. Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged napiragwadsulidid.
We-dulede, neggwebur-dummad-saila-Sergio-Pauloʼba gudiid. Sergio-Pauloʼde, dule-binsaed-ibedid. Geb a-Saila-dummadde Bab-Dummad-gayaburba itomogaga Bernabéʼbina, Sauloʼbina gochagusad.
Ar ibmar-burba-wisid-Barjesús, saila-Sergio-Paulo-binsaed-ganai gualid, adi, mer Bab-Jesús-igar itogegar. Ar Barjesúsʼde, Elimasʼye Griego-gayaba sogleged.
Degi, Saulo, Pabloʼye-nugbalidi, nue Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaled nikasoggu, ise-atakar Elimasʼgi-atakdegu, ega sogded:
“Be bela-bela aimar-yardaked-duled, be dule-isganad, be nia-saila-machid, ibmar-nued-e-isdaradid. Bab-Dummad-Igar-nued-maid be ichodiid, ¿be indakosurde?

Emigindi, Bab-Dummad begi gwisgunonisunnoed, aku-atake be guoed, ibabigbasaale be dad-ibeler bar dakosulid.” Geb a-gines, Elimasʼgi negasichid nagunonikid, aku-atake gunonikid. Dule-argangi-e-nidmalaga aka-aka dule-amidii gualid.
Saila-dummad bela-Bab-Jesús-igar-maid-itosadi, geger nue-itosad. Degidbali, Bab-Jesúsʼgi-bensuli gunonikid.
Pablo, Bernabéʼbo Pisidia-yargi Bab-Igargi sunmaksad
Pablo, eba-gudimaladbo Pafos-neggweburgi-mai, urgi Perge-neggweburse obakdemalad. Pergeʼde Panfilia-yalagangi siid. Juan-Marcosʼdi egi bangude, gannar Jerusalénʼse nade gusad.
A-sorba, Pergeʼgi gudii, Pisidia-yarse, Antioquía-neggweburse nade gusmalad. Degi, obunnoged-ibagi Judíoʼmar-onmakednegse dogdapmalad, agi sigidapmarsunnad.

Moisés-Igar-Maid-absolesad-sorba, degi, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogmalad-garda-maid-absolesad-sorba, Judíoʼmar-onmakedneg-e-dummagan Pabloʼga, degi, Bernabéʼga sokarmalad: “Gwenadgan, bemar gakagwensaar girmarga ibmar sogbiele, sunna be sogmalad.”
Pablo gwisgusa imaksad. Bogidik-ambikumalaga, argan onakwis imaksad. Geb weyob sogded: “Bemar-Israel-dulemar, degi, bela bemar-Bab-Dummad-dobee-nanadimalad, nue an-itomalo:

Bab-Dummad, anmar-Israel-dulemar-e-Bab-Dummad, anmar-dadgan-susagusad. Amba Egipto-yargi maiga gubukwamargu, Bab-Dummad anmar-dadgan-omelosad. Geb degi, Canaán-yarse sedagega, e-ganguedba Egipto-yargi-bukwa onosad.
”Birga-dulabosaar (40) nega-dulesulidganba, anmar-dadgan na e-isdar-nanaedba, gaamakdii gusad.
Anmar-dadgan Canaán-yarse dognonigu, dulemar-akar-akar-sogagugle-bukmalad (7) obelosad, geb amar-yar Bab-Dummad anmar-dadganga uksad.

Bela we-ibmar-gusadi, birga-dulataled-ilabake-gaka-dulabo-gakambe-wilub (450) gusad. ”Geb a-sorbali, Bab-Dummad anmar-dadganga dule-igar-nabiromalad uksagusad, Bab-gayaburba-barsoged-Samuel-mai-gusadse.

Geb degi, anmar-dadgan, rey-nikubi guarmalad. Bab-Dummadse rey-egichismargu, Bab-Dummad ega, Quis-machi-Saúl, uksa-gusad. A-dulede, dad-dummad-Benjamínʼgi danikidid. Saúl birga-dulabo (40) reyga mai-gusad.
Bab-Dummad, Saúl-reyga-maidgi Saúl-obachagusad, geb reyga David-mesnonikid. Bab-Dummad David-annik sogsagusad:
Salmo 89:20
”Bab-Dummad-Igar-Mesisadba-guegala, we-dad-Davidʼgi Israel-dulemar-abonoged ogwisnonikid. A-dulede, Jesúsʼye-nugad.

Jesús amba yoo nonikid-iduar, Diigi-dule-oged-Juan Bab-Dummad-igargi sunmaknonikid. Israel-dulemarga sognonikid: ‘Na be-ulubgi be-isguedga bukib binsamar, be-daed be ogwamarsun, Bab-Dummad-diigi-ogleged-igar be imakmarsun.’

Juan e-arbaed-wilubgan-bergunaigua, sogdegusad: ‘¿Doaye bemar an-bimala? ¿Bab-Dummad-dule-wargwen-barmidagoye-sogsad-duleye be an-bimala? An a-dulesuli. An-sorba-dule-danikiddi, anba bur-dule-dummadid. Degisoggu, e-sapat-dubse-bakar, geg an ei esiked.’ ”
Pablo sogdebalid: “Gwenadgan, bemar-Abraham-e-waganye-sogbukmalad, degi, bemar-Judíoʼsurmalad-Bab-Dummad-dobee-nanadimalad, bemarga we-gayaburba-nued barmilenaid, adi, bemar abonolemalagar.

”Ar Jerusalénʼgi-bukmalad, degi, e-dummagan, aku Jesús-daksamalad. Degine, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogmalad-narmakar-maid, itoged-irba obunnoged-ibagi absodimalan-inigwele, aku amba itosmalad. Degite, dummagan, Bab-Dummad-Gardagi-narmakar-naidba imaksamalad, deun, Jesús-oburgweye sognonimargu.
Amarde, Jesús-gwen-oburgwele-wilubsuli daksamalanad-inigwele, degite, Jesús-oburgwega Pilatoʼse egisnanai gusmalad.
Ar igi Bab-Dummad-Gardagi Jesúsʼgi narmakar nai, deyob bela gusgua, nakrusgi-naid-odesmargu, neg-uangi digsa gusmalad.
”Ar Bab-Dummaddi, Jesús-burgwar-mai gannar odulos gusad.
A-Jesúsʼde, Galilea-akar Jerusalénʼse-eba-nade-gusmaladse na ibabigbasaale magarodii gusad. Emide, a-dulemar dulemar-baiganga Jesúsʼgi ibmar-daksamaladba sunmakdimarsunnad.
”We-gayaburba-nued anmar-dadganga-sogles-gusadi, anmar bemarga egi sunmakdimarmosundo.
Ar anmar e-wagan-gusoggu, Bab-Dummad anmarga we-Jesús-burgwar-maid odulononikid, igi bato Salmo-sogbogwadgi narmakar nai. Agi sognaid:
Salmo 2:7
”Melle Jesús-san-nunguegala, Bab-Dummad gannar Jesús-odulosad. Degidbali, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-maid-sogedba gusad:

content.text: ‘Davidʼga ibmar-napiragwad an nue-ukoye sogsadi, bega an ukoed.’

content: Isaías 55:3
”Degine, Salmosʼgi sognaibalid:

content.text: ‘Ar be-mai-gwage-swilidikid-e-mui gwen neg-uangi onunsaega be imakosulid.’

content: Salmo 16:10
”Ar David, Bab-Dummad-sogedba e-dulamarga ibmar imaksad. David burgwisgu, e-dadgan-abargi diglesad, geb e-san nungusad. Degisoggu, David na dukin egi sunmaksasulid, Jesús-annik sogsagusad.
Ar we-Jesúsʼdi, Bab-Dummad ogwichisad, e-san nungussurgusad, ar ade, Bab-Dummadi Jesús-burgwar-mai odulosad. Degisoggu, Jesús-e-san nungussulid.
”Degisoggu gwenadgan, bemar wisgue-wilubbid, anmar bemarga-sogdiid anmar-gwage-isgudimalad, Jesúsʼgi nabir gwage-isgussuliyob gunonidaye.
A-ulale, bela dulemar Jesúsʼgi-bensurmalad, gwage nudaklenonidaed, ar Moisés-Igar-Maiddi geg dule-gwage nudaked.
¡Nue-salakarmar! Abakalegi Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogmalad-narmaksad bemar-annik we sogele, deun, weyob sogsagusgu:

content.text: An ibmar-bemar-abargi-imakoedi, be geger dakmaloed, be bergumaloed.

content: Habacuc 1:5
Pablo, e-sordamarbo Judíoʼmar-onmakedneggi noarmargu, Judíoʼsurmaladi egi wilenaigusmalad, adi, emarga gannar obunnoged-iba-baidse Jesús-igargi ega sunmakdamalagar.

Pablo, Bernabéʼmala Judíoʼmar-onmakedneggi nodmargu, Judíoʼmar, degi, Judío-igar-abingasmalad, Pabloʼba, degi, Bernabéʼba bukidar nadegusmalad. Amarga Pablo sunmakalid: “Nue salakarmar, bemar Bab-Jesús-igar-amismalad, mer a-igar be iemalo.”
Obunnoged-iba-nagunonigu, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-itomalaga, neggwebur-belasaale ambikunonimalad.
Judíoʼmar dulemar-bukidar-bukwa dakargu, nobgudmalad. Pablo-ibmar-soggwichidi ichodmalad, degi, ukabsadmarbalid.

Pablo, Bernabé-ebo nue-dobsuli gannadgi Judíoʼmar-abin sogded: “Ar bemargar-inse Bab-Dummad-gayaburba soglegoye igar mainad. Ar bemar we-gayaburba obanmarsoggu, burba-geg-bergued be abesurmarsoggu, emigindi, Judíoʼsurmaladga anmar we-gayaburbagi sunmaksunnoed.
Ar Bab-Jesús bato weyob anmarga igar uksad:
Isaías 49:6
Judíoʼsurmalad deyob Pablo-soge-itosmargu, yeer itodmalad, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba nuedye, sogdemalad. Degi, bukidar burba-geg-bergued-abingaoye ega igar-maimaladi Bab-Jesúsʼgi-bengussurmalad.
Agi Bab-Jesús-gayaburba-nued a-yalaganba bela aisakidsunnad.

Ar Judíoʼmardi, Pablo-bareginmalaga, Bernabé-bareginmalaga, omegan-nug-nikamalad-nue-Babgi-binsadiiye-sogdimaladbo, degi, machergan-neggweburgi-nug-nika-gudimaladbo sunmaksa gusmalad. Degidbali, a-yargi Pablo-onogedse, degi, Bernabé-onogedse imaksamalad.

Pablo, degi, Bernabé-ebo a-neggweburgi nodmargu, e-naggi-olli-nanaid obad-obad imaksamalad, adi, oyogega, an be bar wissurmarye, an bega Bab-Jesús-igargi sunmaksamarmoganye. Emigindi, na be-itolegedmarsunye. Pablo, Bernabéʼbo Iconio-neggweburse nadmarsunnad.
Jesúsʼba-nanaimalad Antioquía-neggweburgi-bukwamaladi bela nue-weligwar itosmalad, degi, nue Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaled-nika gudigusmalad.
